# Förvaltarnas fyndjakt – här ser de störst potential

**Feed**: borslunch  
**Published**: 2026-10-26  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Börslunch (EFN) episode from 26 Oct 2026 with Peter Elam Håkansson (East Capital) and Ylva Häggström (Lannebo, transcribed as 'Lundsbörsen'), covering political shocks such as Lula's win in Brazil, Serbia's change of government and French unrest, along with emerging-market opportunities. Häggström pitches the French-listed Spie as cheap after falling to a five-year-low valuation. Elam Håkansson is constructive on Poland and Greek banks (Alpha Bank, Optima Bank), European refiners, Allegro and copper through KGHM. On AI, both say to stay selective and opportunistic rather than euphoric. In Stockholm news, Swedish iGaming stocks fell on the Brazil result, Yubico extended its rally, Boozt guided to the upper end of its margin range and Atlas Copco saw insider buying.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 SPIE — Spie | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

EPS rising steadily while valuation fell to five-year low; 85% recurring revenue; growth mainly outside France.

#### Reasoning

Guest Ylva Häggström (Lannebo) sees French political turmoil creating mispricing in French-listed companies with limited domestic exposure. Spie's earnings keep rising, revenue is largely recurring and Germany is now largest market, yet shares have de-rated sharply. Pitched for long-term holders; she has no view on near-term timing.

#### Sell Triggers

- if earnings estimates start falling
- if French weakness spreads to Germany/other European markets
- if recurring revenue share declines

> *"för den som är in it for the long run så kan det vara ett intressant namn att titta på nu"*

---

### 🟢 ALPHA — Alpha Bank | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Held in both guests' funds; Greek banks a re-rating success story after crisis.

#### Reasoning

Häggström says her team has been fond of Alpha Bank and Greek banks generally, calling it a well-deserved re-rating after years of problems. East Capital also holds it. Both guests hold it in their funds, which shows conviction, but the view is partly backward-looking (re-rating already happened).

#### Sell Triggers

- if Greek economic recovery stalls
- if asset quality deteriorates

> *"Däremot har vi varit förtjusta i Alfabank och grekisk bank generellt"*

---

### 🟢 OPTIMA — Optima Bank | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Elam Håkansson likes the smaller Greek challenger bank, which he sees as somewhat forgotten.

#### Reasoning

Peter Elam Håkansson (East Capital) prefers Optima Bank as an overlooked, smaller Greek challenger. This fits his broader view that banks are the best way to get exposure to growth in fast-growing economies. He gives only a brief mention without detailed reasons.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Greek growth slows
- if challenger growth stalls

> *"Vi gillar även Optima Bank, som vi tycker har glömts bort lite som är en uppstickare"*

---

### 🟡 ALE — Allegro | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Top-10 holding in East Capital New Europe; 'Amazon of Eastern Europe'.

#### Reasoning

Allegro is among East Capital's largest holdings and fits the Polish consumption-led growth thesis (3.8% average GDP growth over 25 years, about 3.5% this year). There is no explicit new buy call, only that they hold it.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Polish consumer growth slows
- if competitive pressure in Polish e-commerce intensifies

> *"det är Allegro som är då egentligen Amazon av Östeuropa"*

---

### 🟡 KGH — KGHM | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Cited as example of copper theme in East Capital portfolios.

#### Reasoning

East Capital has a copper theme in its portfolios and names Polish producer KGHM as an example. This is a holding mention, not an explicit recommendation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if copper prices fall materially

> *"KGHM är en polsk kopparproducent till exempel"*
